title: Permanent Injury Spinner
description: A d100 table for lasting injuries. Roll when the fiction calls for a permanent consequence; the lowest listed cure is the least powerful treatment that removes the condition.
rules: A result is a story consequence, not a replacement for a GM ruling.
Roll d100, or use the spinner on the Injury Desk.
The character record may reference injury ids in its injuries array.
Cures and durations are deliberately explicit so the result can be linked, audited, and healed later.

entries.description: Your head is shattered beyond repair; you are instantly rendered unconscious and die from massive brain damage.
entries.cure: Resurrection/Reincarnate

entries.description: You are blind in that eye but retain your other senses and can still communicate effectively.
entries.cure: Regenerate or a successful Surgery check with a DC of 15.

entries.description: Your nose is gone, leaving a permanent scar and causing you to breathe through your mouth.
entries.cure: Regenerate

entries.description: You are left with an unsightly scar where your earlobe used to be, affecting your appearance and social interactions.
entries.cure: Regenerate or cosmetic surgery

entries.description: Your left cheek is permanently scarred and deformed, altering your appearance significantly.
entries.cure: Regenerate

entries.description: Your right arm is severed at the shoulder; you can only perform one-handed actions and face a -2 penalty to all one-handed tasks.
entries.cure: Regenerate

entries.description: Every step causes excruciating pain and a -2 penalty to movement speed; you must remain stationary for at least 1 hour after moving.
entries.cure: Regenerate limb, major surgery

entries.description: You lose the use of your left hand for intricate tasks and are unable to wield two-handed weapons effectively.
entries.cure: Prosthetic or Regeneration
entries.notes: Shields and crossbows are allowed on the left side.

entries.description: You limp painfully, reducing your mobility and requiring constant care to prevent infection.
entries.cure: Prosthetic or Regeneration
entries.notes: Regular cleaning and maintenance are crucial to avoid complications.

entries.description: All nearby allies must succeed on a DC12 CON save or succumb to the pain, offering aid and comfort in their efforts to alleviate your suffering.
entries.cure: Surviving a successful DC15 CON check from an ally

entries.description: You are in excruciating pain and only moments away from death. At the end of each long rest, you can make a DC15 CON saving throw; on a success, you survive another day.
entries.cure: Death
entries.duration: Until dead or cured by DM's fiat

entries.description: You instantly collapse and have disadvantage on all ability checks and saving throws until you are stabilized.
entries.cure: DC15 Medicine check to stabilize

entries.description: The victim rapidly weakens and collapses, increasing the chance of fatal outcomes on death saving throws.
entries.cure: DC20 Medicine check to stabilize

entries.description: You choke on your own blood, immediately suffering a failed death saving throw.
entries.cure: DC18 Medicine check or receive immediate medical attention

entries.description: The player's lower body becomes paralyzed and they are confined to a wheelchair until their spine can be healed.
entries.cure: Greater Restoration or 6th-level Heal spell

entries.description: Endures excruciating pain and suffers disadvantage on all Strength-based actions.
entries.cure: Healing spell at 3rd level or higher

entries.description: Your leg feels weak and heavy, hampering your movement and agility. You suffer disadvantage on Dexterity (Athletics) checks.
entries.cure: A 5th-level healing spell or 4 weeks of bed rest and physical therapy.

entries.description: Suffers from constant headaches and is limited to using only one hand.
entries.cure: Healing spell of at least 3rd level or a successful surgery.

entries.description: Your spine is fractured in such a way that any attempt to move your legs without assistance results in intense pain and a DC20 Strength check failure.
entries.cure: Greater Restoration spell

entries.description: You endure a steady loss of vitality; each dawn, your hit point maximum decreases by 2 points until fully exhausted.
entries.cure: 4th level healing spell or 3 doses of Bloodroot Extract

entries.description: You must endure a perpetual state of breathlessness and reduced lung capacity, requiring daily treatments to manage the symptoms. Only a powerful healing spell can cure this condition.
entries.cure: 4th level healing spell

entries.description: Your spine is fractured in multiple places, rendering you immobile and unable to take actions or bonus actions until fully healed.
entries.cure: 4th level healing spell

entries.description: The victim's arms and legs are permanently paralyzed, rendering them unable to move or use these limbs for any function.
entries.cure: Greater Restoration or a Wish spell
entries.notes: Seek magical aid immediately as paralysis can lead to atrophy.

entries.description: You endure persistent pain and must make a DC 15 Constitution save at the start of each hour; failure results in doubling your movement speed until you rest.
entries.cure: A 4th level healing spell or equivalent magical effect

entries.description: Sustains a severe concussion that clouds the mind and leaves you disoriented, imposing disadvantage on all concentration-related activities.
entries.cure: A successful DC14 Cure Wounds spell or similar spell

entries.description: Your throat is grievously torn, leaving you unable to speak or swallow without excruciating pain.
entries.cure: Greater Restoration or a successful Wish spell
entries.notes: Seek immediate treatment; delays may lead to infection and further complications.

entries.description: Your abdomen swells as your liver begins to shut down completely.
entries.cure: Greater Restoration or a Wish spell
entries.notes: Affects digestion and energy levels.

entries.description: You limp severely and find it difficult to stand steadily. Attempting to sprint or jump causes intense pain, requiring a DC18 CON saving throw or you fall prone.
entries.cure: 4th level heal spell

entries.description: Your mind feels clouded; every time you cast a spell, it takes an action to concentrate and you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or lose the spell.
entries.cure: A successful Wish spell or 4th level cure wounds spell

entries.description: Your right leg feels heavy and weak, significantly hampering your mobility and speed in combat.
entries.cure: A 5th level Heal spell or 4 weeks of bed rest and physical therapy.
entries.notes: Pain is excruciating during movement. Avoid intense activities until fully healed.

entries.description: Your powerful lower leg muscles are damaged, making it impossible to run or perform any activity requiring significant leg strength. This severely limits your mobility and physical capabilities.
entries.cure: 3rd level heal spell or equivalent magic item
entries.notes: While recovering, you are limited to walking only short distances with aid.

entries.description: Your right hand is mangled, rendering it nearly useless for fine motor tasks and unable to wield heavy weapons.
entries.cure: 2nd level heal or a successful surgery check
entries.notes: Consider using the hand cautiously even after healing as it may still be less dexterous.

entries.description: Your ankle swells to twice its normal size, severely restricting your mobility and balance.
entries.cure: 2nd level heal or magic item healing property

entries.description: Every day, you must endure excruciating pain and perform a short rest to avoid further internal bleeding.
entries.cure: Fourth level healing magic or successful surgery at an apothecary.
entries.notes: Seek help immediately; prolonged suffering can lead to fatal complications.

entries.description: Every time you cast a spell, you must succeed on a DC12 concentration check or risk losing your spell slot.
entries.cure: Complete bed rest for 3 days and a successful DC15 Wisdom (Medicine) check
entries.notes: Avoid strenuous activities until fully recovered to prevent worsening the injury.

entries.description: Your vision is blurred, making it difficult to focus on small details and reducing your ability to perceive the environment accurately.
entries.cure: A 2nd level healing spell or a week of rest in a darkened room.

entries.description: Your nose is severely disfigured, impairing your sense of smell and causing a constant runny nose.
entries.cure: Major surgery or successful cosmetic surgery roll
entries.notes: Social interactions may become challenging due to the appearance.

entries.description: Every time you engage in combat or strenuous activity, you must succeed on a DC12 CON save to avoid passing out from the pain.
entries.cure: Greater restoration spell
entries.notes: During this time, you are at risk of further damage if exposed to hostile conditions.

entries.description: Each time you perform an action, you must succeed on a DC12 Constitution saving throw or fall to the ground in pain.
entries.cure: A 3rd-level healing spell
entries.notes: Avoid strenuous activities during this time.

entries.description: Your spine becomes rigid, immobilizing your legs and causing excruciating pain.
entries.cure: Greater restoration or a successful Wish spell
entries.duration: Until the cause is removed; permanent without treatment
entries.notes: This injury does not heal on its own.

entries.description: The liver is bruised, causing a persistent poisoned state that saps vitality.
entries.cure: Greater Restoration or 4th level Heal spell

entries.description: The world around you darkens, and you are left in a perpetual state of near-total blindness.
entries.cure: Greater Restoration

entries.description: You suffer from profound hearing loss in your right ear, making it difficult to understand speech at normal volumes.
entries.cure: Greater restoration or similar magic

entries.description: Each time you attempt to use your Strength in combat or movement, you must succeed on a DC15 CON save; otherwise, you are immobilized for the duration of the action.
entries.cure: Magical healing or two long rests

entries.description: At the end of each round while conscious, you suffer a sharp pain and incur 1d4 slashing damage.
entries.cure: Magical healing or successful Surgery check

entries.description: Your right wrist is stiff and painful, hampering your ability to perform delicate gestures required for spellcasting. You must make a DC12 DEX save before each attempt; failure results in the spell failing.
entries.cure: Healing magic or long rest

entries.description: Your step is unsteady; each movement feels like walking on hot coals, and you risk tripping with every cautious step.
entries.cure: Rest and healing magic

entries.description: Your bicep is severely strained, causing you to have disadvantage on all Strength checks and saving throws involving your right arm.
entries.cure: Magical healing or 3 days of rest and light activity

entries.description: Your right thigh feels tight and painful; you risk falling if you run or sprint. Any movement that strains your leg forces you to make a DEX saving throw.
entries.cure: Magical healing or two weeks of bed rest

entries.description: Each night, you must make a DC15 WIS save to avoid being overwhelmed by debilitating fear when encountering the source of your phobia.
entries.cure: DC25 Psychology check or successful DC20 Medicine check each week for 4 weeks
entries.notes: Weekly checks are required; failure increases fear sensitivity.

entries.description: You feel an overwhelming sense of worthlessness and are at a -2 penalty on all social interactions.
entries.cure: DC15 Psychology check each week
entries.notes: One psychology check per week to lift the despair.

entries.description: You are plagued by vivid nightmares every night, forcing you to make a DC15 Wisdom save before each Short Rest. On failure, you become exhausted until the end of your next Long Rest.
entries.cure: DC20 Medicine check per day

entries.description: You are haunted by vivid, recurring nightmares that plague your sleep, forcing you to make a DC14 Wisdom save at the start of every night. Failure results in a state of heightened anxiety and one point of exhaustion.
entries.cure: DC18 Medicine or Psychology check each week
entries.notes: One check per week is required for treatment.

entries.description: You are haunted by the memory of your addiction, affecting your judgment.
entries.cure: Pass a DC15 Medicine check each week to regain control.
entries.notes: One check per week.

entries.description: You can no longer recall the events of a crucial battle, as if they were shrouded in a thick fog.
entries.cure: No cure; the lost memories may never return.

entries.description: You are overcome by an intense and paralyzing fear, unable to move or act for the duration of a short rest.
entries.cure: Short rest in a safe environment

entries.description: You become overwhelmed by extreme fear whenever you encounter a creature that resembles the source of your trauma. This terror compels you to flee, even if it means leaving comrades behind.
entries.cure: One long rest away from all sources of trauma
entries.duration: Until the end of the session

entries.description: You suffer from constant dread and fear, reducing your initiative by 2 until you rest for a day.
entries.cure: A week of meditation or equivalent calming activities.
entries.duration: Until you rest for a full day

entries.description: You are haunted by vivid, recurring nightmares that interfere with your ability to focus and make decisions.
entries.cure: One long rest and a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Insight) check.
entries.notes: The GM may require you to make additional checks if the fear recurs.

entries.description: You suffer from severe self-doubt and must make a DC15 Will save each day. On failure, you lose the use of your primary weapon or tool for the next encounter.
entries.cure: Completion of a successful task using your primary weapon or tool.
entries.notes: GM note: This injury can be cured by demonstrating competence in your chosen field.

entries.description: Every morning you must make a DC15 WIS save to avoid losing your place in the conversation, often resulting in social blunders.
entries.cure: A successful DC20 INT check provided by another creature.

entries.description: You become deeply distrustful of your companions and surroundings, constantly questioning their intentions. At the start of each of your turns, you must succeed on a DC14 WIS save or believe that someone in sight is trying to deceive you and react with hostility.
entries.cure: Long rest

entries.description: At the start of each of your turns, you must make a DC15 WIS save. On failure, you immediately Dash to safety if possible.
entries.cure: Calm spell or similar magic

entries.description: You lose all reason and target the nearest living creature within reach with unbridled fury, attacking without regard for your allies or enemies.
entries.cure: Concentration by a trusted ally for 1 hour

entries.description: Your stride is significantly reduced by 15 feet until healed.
entries.cure: Rest and minor healing magic

entries.description: Your favored arm becomes temporarily cumbersome, slowing your actions and impeding dexterity-based tasks.
entries.cure: Rest and a potion of healing

entries.description: Your hearing becomes significantly muffled, making it difficult to discern detailed sounds.
entries.cure: Rest and quiet environment for 2d6 hours

entries.description: Your tongue swells to twice its normal size, making it difficult to speak and swallow. You are unable to eat or drink normally.
entries.cure: Major healing spell or 2d8 weeks of bed rest
entries.notes: Speak softly to avoid strain on your vocal cords.

entries.description: Each morning for the next week, you must make a DC14 CON save or be immobile due to excruciating pain.
entries.cure: Rest and bandage application (Healer skill check)

entries.description: Each time you use your reaction to interrupt an attack or cast a spell, you must succeed on a DC10 CON save or lose it immediately.
entries.cure: Magical healing

entries.description: You experience a throbbing headache that clouds your vision and makes it difficult to focus, causing you to lose concentration on spells.
entries.cure: A short rest or the use of an appropriate potion

entries.description: Your shoulder feels out of joint and reduces your strength by -2.
entries.cure: A successful DC15 Medicine check or healing magic restores it.

entries.description: Your finger is immobilized, causing a -2 penalty to ranged attack rolls.
entries.cure: A successful DC15 Medicine check or healing magic.

entries.description: Temporary cloudiness in your vision causing you to see double and reducing your perception by half on sight-based checks.
entries.cure: Rest for 1d6 hours or a successful DC10 Medicine check.
entries.duration: 2d8 hours, Instant with rest or treatment

entries.description: Your clothing is in tatters, leaving you exposed to the elements and the gaze of others.
entries.cure: A tailor's needle or similar repair kit.
entries.duration: Instantly repaired with a long rest and basic tools.

entries.description: Your hair is now significantly shorter than before, but it does not impair your appearance or function.
entries.cure: None; this effect is permanent.

entries.description: A permanent reminder of your battle; a scar that tells the tale of your resilience and survival.
entries.cure: None
entries.notes: Emphasize the narrative importance of this injury. It's not just a physical mark, but a symbol of enduring strength.

entries.description: A telltale mark that endures even when the body heals—your armor bears witness to your ordeal.
entries.cure: None

entries.description: When you fall, the ground arranges itself to be a soft and cushioned bed of leaves and moss, ensuring minimal impact upon landing.
entries.cure: Instant with rest

entries.description: One of your treasured magical artifacts begins to malfunction and lose its powers over time.
entries.cure: Restoration magic, such as Greater Restoration, can reverse this effect.

entries.description: Instantly activate a random magic item you are carrying or in your inventory, potentially triggering its effects without needing to use an action.
entries.cure: None

entries.description: While you are unconscious, a nearby ally, guided by the GM, delivers one attack roll against you as a bonus action.
entries.cure: None

entries.description: While wearing armour, any attack made against you provides a +1 bonus to your AC for the next round.
entries.cure: None
entries.duration: Instantaneous effect lasting one combat round
entries.notes: Note that this might encourage foes to target others in combat.

entries.description: Incorporate the power of a vise within your grasp, inflicting a grapple check against any who seek to free you. Should you succeed, they are slammed to the ground beside you.
entries.cure: Breaking the Grasp successfully in a new grapple check or disarming action.
entries.notes: This grip can only be removed by defeating your hold through combat.

entries.description: For the next hour, you gain insight into your opponent's next action and can react to it immediately.
entries.cure: None

entries.description: For the next hour, you feel a wave of calm and safety as though nothing could possibly harm you.
entries.cure: None

entries.description: Your next successful leap or jump is doubled in height and distance.
entries.cure: None

entries.description: Your next attack hits with a stunning precision, guaranteeing critical success.
entries.cure: None

entries.description: Your determination is unwavering; you gain advantage on will saves and resistances to fear effects until the end of your next short rest.
entries.cure: A short rest
entries.duration: Until the end of your next short rest

entries.description: A deep scar runs down the center of your chest, leaving a constant reminder of your ordeal and granting you advantage on Intimidation checks.
entries.cure: None

entries.description: Gain a +2 bonus to all Charisma checks and saving throws involving persuasion or performance.
entries.cure: None

entries.description: Gain +1 bonus to Intimidate checks and rolls with heavy armor; scars are a testament to your bravery.
entries.cure: None
entries.notes: Must be wearing heavy armor for the bonuses to apply.

entries.description: Your body's pain signals override your combat instincts, causing you to fall and feign incapacitation as soon as the fight begins.
entries.cure: Restoration spell or similar magic
entries.notes: GMs may rule that enemies can shake you awake if they suspect it is a ruse.

entries.description: Your wounds are so severe they seem almost non-existent to others, allowing you to slip unnoticed even in the most dire circumstances.
entries.cure: Rest and healing magic
entries.notes: Enemies may underestimate your condition, giving you a chance to escape or surprise them.

entries.description: You can recover from a critical hit as if it were merely a minor wound, but you still count as having taken damage.
entries.cure: A long rest or successful Medicine check (DC 15)

entries.description: Gains a second chance when on the brink of death, effectively reducing the chances of succumbing to fatal wounds.
entries.cure: None

entries.description: Gains an additional successful death saving throw and can make a second attempt if failing the first.
entries.cure: None

entries.description: You will be stabilized after a successful death save and receive an immediate second chance at life.
entries.cure: None

entries.description: Your body remains in a state of suspended animation until medical attention can be provided.
entries.cure: Immediate emergency care and resuscitation efforts
entries.duration: Instantly enters stasis; lasts until treated
entries.notes: Players must act quickly to prevent permanent brain damage.

entries.description: At the beginning of each of your turns, you gain an extra action and a +1 bonus to hit on all attacks until your next short or long rest.
entries.cure: None
entries.duration: Until your next short or long rest
entries.notes: While this surge gives you an edge in combat, it leaves you exhausted afterward.

entries.description: Your limb becomes encased in a network of iron-like veins that give you heightened strength but restrict movement.
entries.cure: Major surgery or removal by an Artisan Surgeon.

entries.description: Your flesh mends only to be consumed by ethereal chains that bind your movements, halving your speed and imposing disadvantage on all Dexterity checks.
entries.cure: Restoration spell or a successful Wish spell

entries.description: Your body harbors a hidden sentinel that can attack any enemy within reach during combat, striking with your proficiency in melee attacks.
entries.cure: Major surgery and a week of bed rest
entries.notes: The sentinel only activates when you are engaged in combat. Enemies may not be aware of its presence.

entries.description: Your voice becomes muffled and indistinct to all but yourself, a permanent reminder of your past struggles.
entries.cure: Major Restoration Ritual (3d6 hours)

entries.description: Your voice becomes a haunting echo that can be heard by allies within 30 feet, but not enemies.
entries.cure: Remove with a successful spell save against a dispelling magic effect.

entries.description: Your veins are left with a permanent jagged scar, causing blood to clot unpredictably.
entries.cure: Major surgery and two months of rest and recovery
entries.notes: Avoid strenuous activities. The scars can be hidden with armor.

entries.description: Your arm or leg is permanently misshapen, granting you an advantage on saving throws related to being grabbed but dealing disadvantage to Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks.
entries.cure: Surgery and a year of careful physiotherapy.
entries.notes: May require multiple surgeries for optimal alignment.

entries.description: A dark shadow clings to your body, radiating an aura that saps the vitality of those who gaze upon it for more than a minute.
entries.cure: Major Restoration spell or equivalent magic
entries.duration: Instantaneous, but reoccurs if not cured
entries.notes: Those affected by the Shadowed Aura must save against a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 2d6 necrotic damage per minute they remain in your presence.

entries.description: Your skin turns a pale blue, and you gain the ability to inflict frost damage upon touch for 1d6 cold damage plus your Constitution modifier.
entries.cure: Healing Staff or successful Cure spell
entries.duration: Permanent with monthly checks to stabilize
entries.notes: Monthly checks are required to prevent the condition from worsening into a state of permanent ice corruption.

entries.description: Your skin becomes permanently marred by iridescent, crystalline growths that pulse with a faint, otherworldly light.
entries.cure: Major surgery and 4d12 weeks of rest

entries.description: A shard of obsidian lodges in your heart, causing constant pain and weakening your vital functions.
entries.cure: Major surgery or a successful removal by an Archmage.

entries.description: A patch of skin on your face is permanently discolored, obscuring vision in that eye.
entries.cure: Major surgery or magical removal at the cost of a week's rest and 500 gp.
entries.notes: This may hinder close combat but offers no tactical advantage.

entries.description: Your eyesight remains unimpaired, but you gain a permanent, unsettling gaze that unnerves those who look upon you.
entries.cure: Major surgery and 1 year of rest
entries.notes: Players may choose to role-play the psychological effects this has on interactions with NPCs.

entries.description: The lost limb continues to be felt, causing constant pain and phantom sensations.
entries.cure: Major surgery or a replacement limb with magic augmentation (at GM discretion).
entries.notes: This injury can only occur once per character.

entries.description: Your touch becomes incorporeal, affecting only creatures with physical form. Allies may ignore your presence in combat.
entries.cure: Dispel Magic

entries.description: A noxious aura that spreads a foul stench and clouds the mind, hindering perception and inspiring fear in others.
entries.cure: A thorough cleansing ritual or a successful DC 15 Medicine check.
entries.notes: The emanation can be detected within 30 feet by anyone not successfully resisting the effect.

entries.description: You feel a phantom presence reacting to hostile actions within 30 feet.
entries.cure: 2d6 weeks of rest and ritual purification.
entries.notes: Enemies may sense your ethereal retribution. Allies should be cautious.

entries.description: You are constantly plagued by the sensation of a phantom limb, which can only be alleviated with rigorous concentration and meditation.
entries.cure: A week of uninterrupted meditation in a sacred location.

entries.description: Your body is suffused with a ghostly aura, making you nearly invisible to all but those who know where and how to look.
entries.cure: Major Restoration spell or equivalent magic item
entries.notes: Only creatures trained in the art of detection can see through your ethereal veil.

entries.description: A ghostly wound that bleeds an unseen fluid, causing constant pain and leaving an ethereal trail wherever you move.
entries.cure: Restoration spell or similar magic
entries.duration: Instant, but reappears after 1d6 days if not permanently cured
entries.notes: The spectral blood can be stopped by a successful DC 20 Medicine check.

entries.description: Your flesh has been replaced by an impenetrable stone, rendering you immobile and impervious to most attacks.
entries.cure: Major surgery or a successful Wish spell
entries.notes: This condition is both a boon and a curse. While it protects from harm, it also prevents movement.

entries.description: Your body hums with an otherworldly resonance, making it difficult for you to remain unseen or unheard by those with keen senses.
entries.cure: Complete rest and a successful DC 20 Medicine check.

entries.description: Your body becomes entwined with a spectral embrace that only you can feel, causing constant discomfort and affecting your movements.
entries.cure: Restoration spell or successful DC 20 Medicine check after 1 week of rest.
entries.duration: Long rest each day for 4 weeks

entries.description: A vein in your body becomes encased in ice, reducing your stamina by 2d4 until thawed.
entries.cure: Cold resistance potion or successful healing spell (DC15)
entries.notes: Avoid cold environments to prevent further damage.

entries.description: Your skin turns permanently frostbitten, causing constant pain and making you susceptible to cold temperatures.
entries.cure: Major surgery and a month of healing with a restful environment.
entries.notes: Avoids direct contact with cold elements or risk severe injury.

entries.description: You feel a constant pain from a limb that no longer exists, as if it were still attached to your body.
entries.cure: Major restoration or Wish spell
entries.notes: The phantom limb is real and can be fought with physical therapy or magical means.

entries.description: Your flesh becomes unstable, shifting and warping with each passing moment, causing discomfort and unpredictable physical changes.
entries.cure: Restoration spell or a successful DC 25 Medicine check by another healer.

entries.description: A ghostly cloak envelopes your form, visible only to allies within 30 feet. It grants +2 AC but you can't enter areas of total cover.
entries.cure: Dismiss with a successful DC 15 Arcana check or after 1d4 weeks.
entries.duration: Until dismissed or the duration ends

entries.description: Your mind becomes entwined with the veil, granting you insight into hidden truths but at a cost to your sanity.
entries.cure: Complete a year and a day of meditation and isolation from the veiled world.
entries.notes: Players may gain temporary bonuses to Insight checks in certain environments, but lose 1d4 Wisdom permanently.

entries.description: Your skin becomes a vessel for spectral presences, attracting minor ethereal creatures that you can neither control nor shake off without a major ritual.
entries.cure: Major Restoration spell or equivalent magical intervention
entries.notes: While the presence is there, you are always aware of its proximity and feel its touch.

entries.description: A festering growth of living darkness consumes your flesh, emitting a cold, eerie light.
entries.cure: Elixir of Resurrection and a week of rest in a Holy Ground.
entries.notes: Avoid contact with water or it spreads faster.

entries.description: An invisible scar pulses with a faint glow, causing constant pain and a nagging ache.
entries.cure: Major rest and 50 gp worth of healing magic.

entries.description: You hear an eternal echo of your last spoken word, disrupting focus and communication.
entries.cure: Complete Silence Ritual

entries.description: Your body is suffused with a mystic aura that disrupts your concentration, reducing your spellcasting ability by half.
entries.cure: Major rest and a successful DC 18 Wisdom (Medicine) check

entries.description: The mind is cloaked in a spectral veil, confusing thoughts and memories. Only clear thinking can pierce the mist.
entries.cure: A day of uninterrupted meditation or study

entries.description: Your flesh mends only to shift the wound elsewhere.
entries.cure: Major restoration spell

entries.description: Your body becomes entwined with an ethereal veil that disrupts your alignment and magic. Your spells are unstable, and you suffer a -2 penalty to all spell checks.
entries.cure: A successful Wish or Miracle spell cast by another character.

entries.description: Your body becomes partially ethereal, causing you to float at a height of one foot above the ground. This makes it difficult for others to touch or grapple you.
entries.cure: Major rest and an Ethereal Anchor spell

entries.description: Your limb becomes as brittle as bone and can shatter under minimal stress. You suffer -2 to Strength checks.
entries.cure: Restoration spell or a successful Craft Medicine check with DC 15
entries.duration: Instantly cured, but re-injury lasts until long rest

entries.description: A spectral veil obscures the heart's rhythm, causing palpitations and a weakening of resolve.
entries.cure: Restoration spell or equivalent magical treatment

entries.description: A permanent veil of mysticism cloaks your form, granting you supernatural sight within 30 feet but causing you to be disoriented in bright or chaotic environments.
entries.cure: Removing the Mystic Veil Binding (129)

entries.description: Your body is intertwined with a phantom echo that mimics your voice and movements.
entries.cure: Dispel Magic spell
entries.notes: The echoes cannot be silenced or ignored.

entries.description: Your heart feels like it is encased in ice, impeding your ability to feel warmth.
entries.cure: Warmth infusion or a successful DC 30 Medicine check.

entries.description: Your body becomes entangled in an invisible spectral web, hampering your movements and reducing Dexterity by 2.
entries.cure: Rest for 1 week and a successful DC 20 Medicine check.
entries.duration: Until cured or removed by magic.

entries.description: Your voice is warped by an otherworldly veil, rendering you unintelligible to all but those who can see through the mystical distortion.
entries.cure: Restoration spell or a successful DC 20 Charisma (Performance) check

entries.description: Your vision is clouded by an ever-present veil of shadow that distorts your perception. Enemies appear as distorted shadows.
entries.cure: Major restoration, greater restoration, or a wish spell.
entries.duration: Forever, but fades with time and effort to dispel it.

entries.description: Your bones now whisper cryptic messages that only you can hear. They drain your concentration and may interfere with magical effects.
entries.cure: Complete bone realignment surgery and a month of rest in a quiet environment.
entries.notes: GM note: Consider the messages as interruptions during combat or spellcasting.

entries.description: Your soul hums with a foreign echo, sapping your resolve. Your morale suffers in combat.
entries.cure: A week of meditation and rest to restore harmony within.

entries.description: Your blood runs as cold as ice, congealing and slowing your body's functions. You are immune to fire-based damage.
entries.cure: A successful Medicine check or a Frost Mastery spell of at least 5th level.

entries.description: Your bones seem to whisper secrets of the past. They fracture easily and emit a constant eerie glow.
entries.cure: Spectral Bone Mender ritual, performed by an Arcane Healer
entries.notes: Players must avoid areas with strong magical fields.

entries.description: Your vision becomes fragmented and hazy, as if seen through a veil of mist.
entries.cure: 2d6 hours of rest or an hour under bright light

entries.description: Your vision is clouded by an ever-present veil of spectral mist, reducing all sight to silvery haze.
entries.cure: Restoration spell or equivalent magic, lasting 3d6 weeks

entries.description: A searing pain that pulses every hour, causing a -1 penalty to all saving throws. The wound bleeds ethereally.
entries.cure: Major Restoration spell

entries.description: Your voice is muffled and indistinct to others. They can still hear you but understand you with difficulty.
entries.cure: Spectral Mender's Cure, Long rest

entries.description: Your voice is warped by the spectral veil, rendering you unable to speak normally. Those who hear your words are compelled to misunderstand them.
entries.cure: Restoration spell or similar magic

entries.description: You hear only whispers and echoes, as if the world has dimmed into a spectral dream.
entries.cure: Silent Ritual or equivalent magic

entries.description: Your hand is cloaked in an ethereal veil that impairs your dexterity.
entries.cure: A successful DC 15 Arcana check or access to a Lesser Restoration spell.

entries.description: You hear the faint whispers of those you've harmed, haunting your every moment.
entries.cure: Silent Veil Remedy or removal of the source of the echo.

entries.description: Your limb is encased in an ever-present veil that impedes movement and grants no strength. It feels heavy and sluggish.
entries.cure: Major restoration spell or equivalent magic item

entries.description: Your hand is shrouded in shadow, halving your dexterity and imposing disadvantage on stealth checks.
entries.cure: Major Surgery or Restoration spell
entries.notes: The shadow recedes with rest, but full function returns only after treatment.

entries.description: Your bones are intertwined with spectral threads that limit your mobility and slow your attacks.
entries.cure: A successful DC 18 Medicine check or the Dispel Magic spell.

entries.description: Your voice echoes with otherworldly tones, confusing allies and drawing the attention of fiends.
entries.cure: Silencing potion or 3d6 hours of rest in a consecrated location

entries.description: Your skin becomes permeable to ethereal entities; they can touch you at will.
entries.cure: A successful caster level check against DC 18 or a week of seclusion.
entries.notes: Avoid places with powerful ethereal presences.

entries.description: Your veins pulse with an eerie glow, sapping your strength and making you vulnerable to cold climates.
entries.cure: A week of herbal remedies and warm baths restores the normal flow of blood.

entries.description: Your veins have been warped by the spectral veil, causing erratic blood flow and severe pain.
entries.cure: Major Restoration or successful Surgery (DC 25)

entries.description: Your veins pulse with an eerie, spectral light, draining your vitality and leaving you susceptible to cold-based attacks.
entries.cure: Restoration spell or equivalent magic

entries.description: A pulsating void opens in your veins, causing severe hemorrhaging and excruciating pain.
entries.cure: Major surgery or a successful DC 25 Medicine check by another healer.
entries.notes: May require multiple sessions of treatment.

entries.description: A twisted network of veins causes constant pain and unpredictable bursts of ethereal energy.
entries.cure: Surgery and 4d8 weeks of rest to realign the malformed vessels.

entries.description: Your veins pulse with ethereal echoes that drain your strength and stamina.
entries.cure: Complete rest and a successful DC 20 Wisdom (Medicine) check.

replacement: These 100 reference entries are temporary and may be replaced by a future AI-generated table after review.
